newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Micro Therapeutics started. [corrected 18:50 gmt]
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Micro Therapeutics started. [corrected 18:50 gmt]

text.p: -- UBS Securities said analyst Samuel Navarro initiated coverage of Micro Therapeutics Inc with a strong buy rating. (Corrects rating from "buy" to "strong buy".)
-- said Micro has proprietary tehcnologies that address two underserved markets (peripheral vascular and neurovascular therapies) using minimally invasive approaches.
-- projects company to reach profitability in year 2000, with revenue of $51 million and fully taxed earnings of $0.78 a share.
-- estimates loss $1.51 a share in 1997, compared with loss of $1.40 a share in 1996.
